decisions.summary: Added --leader ID flag: rotates system.initial.view so chosen replica leads view 0; reads n from system.servers.num; validates range; deletes currentView before run so BFT-SMaRt re-reads fresh
Added --randomize-leader flag: picks seeded random leader per run, passes --leader ID to run-omnet-simulation.sh; defaults to replica 0 when omitted
leaderReplicaId NED param controls PROPOSE_ALL leader; getCurrentViewLeader returns configuredLeaderReplicaId; --leader writes leader_override.ini instead of patching system.config

getCurrentViewLeader: use configuredLeaderReplicaId if in physicallyObservedCars, else fall back to min-ID — fixes ByzLeader regression where Byzantine replica 0 was trying to be PROPOSE_ALL leader and stalling on cert collection timeout

Self-delivery bypass fix: Java routes target==me through C++ sim-time schedule (BFTMessage type 100) instead of instant deliverToBFTSmart. Plot fix: consensus latency now uses propose_all_consensus_latency_sim_s (500ms) not wall clock (1.728s).
Added syncTimeToJava() to handleClientRequestBroadcast (type-9 path was missing clock sync). Added [TIMING] ENTRY/QUEUE/EXIT logs at all four message lifecycle points for zero-sim-time diagnosis.
Trailing car stopTime: ring-entry primary (matches Raft), speed poll fallback, no ORDER-time contamination
